title: Action Mode — Turn your voice into action | Voice Cursor
excerpt: Find files, send emails, schedule meetings, and more with your voice. Explore Action Mode, now in beta, with Voice Cursor.
content_html:
Get started with Action Mode

While Voice Cursor downloads, take a look at these two ways to get started.

  1. 01Join the community

    Get help, share feedback, and discover what others are doing with Action Mode.

    Join Discord

  2. 02Enable Action Mode

    Use the setup guide, then try finding files, drafting emails, or scheduling meetings.

    Open the guide

Action Mode · Beta

Say what you need.Voice Cursor gets it done.

Find files, send emails, schedule meetings, and more—with your voice.

Watch the demo

From voice to text.

Now, voice to action.

Tell Voice Cursor what you need done. It takes action in your apps.Tell Voice Cursor what you need. It takes action in your apps.

Search across your work

Finder

Describe what you need. Voice Cursor finds it and opens it for you.

  • Example request

    “Find the Q4 planning file I worked on last week.”

  • Example request

    “Show me the emails I need to reply to today.”

  • Example request

    “Find the thread where Andrew shared the launch timeline.”

  • Example request

    “Find the API launch progress sync next week.”

Share a file in Slack

Tell Voice Cursor what to do. It handles the action in the right app.

Example request

“Share this document in our team's Slack channel”

Coordinate a meeting

Say the whole task.

Give one request, including what to check and what to do next.

Example request

“Check my calendar, book a meeting with Andrew tomorrow afternoon, and email him the project plan.”

Privacy

You’re still in charge.You stay in control.

Review actions before they run, or enable auto-execute for a hands-free experience.Choose whether to review each step first or let Action Mode move faster.

See each proposed action and approve it before Voice Cursor continues.

Let Voice Cursor complete approved workflows without pausing for every step.

Action Mode · Beta

Try it. Tell us what you think.

Action Mode is in beta. Help shape what it does next.
